N1: FailSafe 6.0.13 adds a simple path from your development Console to Statewright.
N2: Open FailSafe in VS Code, and launch the Console from the Command Palette.
N3: Select Integrations, then Catalog. Here you'll find Statewright AI, clearly labeled as a website handoff.
N4: Select Open Statewright Run History, and Statewright opens in your browser.
N5: Statewright shows its own Run History page. This account has no runs yet. They appear once a workflow is activated in a connected Statewright client. FailSafe does not import that history or enforce those workflows. This card is a link, not a connection.
N6: Open Statewright run history from FailSafe. Version 6.0.13 is available now.
